description: Ask about markets and world events and get Antevo's published read with its evidence: the daily Executive Brief, a graded risk radar paired with the reading that would confirm or kill each risk, per-sector desk notes from shipping to art, a nine-layer world map down to chokepoints and subsea cables, and macro-economic history for around 180 countries — some series back to 1920. Every answer is dated and names its source. Public and read-only: no account, no sign-in, and no tool that can change anything.
